note: Superior NF (Kawishiwi district) campground on Birch Lake about 13 miles from Ely, in two wooded loops with a boat ramp and two camper cabins; the 14 Birch Lake backcountry sites are separate. The forest says sites are pull-in, 'not specifically designed for RVs', and most fit 'a moderately sized vehicle'; Recreation.gov lists most at 36 ft or more. Sites 6, 12, 18 and 19 sit by the shore; most others see the lake through the trees. ATVs are not allowed. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read: 29 standard non-electric sites (18 reservable, North 002-012 FCFS), $21, 6-month window, 14-night max, May 1-Sept 26, vault toilets and hand pump. Stored lakefront checked hard against rec.gov site points and site photos: lakefront holds on a few sites (006, 012, 018, 019, water just past the table across open ground), most others see the lake through trees. Count 32 -> 29.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, checked hard): keep lakefront with a caveat naming the sites. The rec.gov site photos show the lake directly beyond the table across open ground or scattered trees at 018 and 019 (south loop, on the SW bay; rec.gov points 47.75697,-91.78552 and 47.75683,-91.78533, about 30 m from the water on imagery), 006 (47.75975,-91.78014; water past the table through a gap in the shrubs) and 012 (47.76091,-91.77937; water just past a thin line of saplings). Lake visible through trees from 003, 004, 007 and 029 (lakeview at best). On imagery the NE-shore points (001-014) sit 45-60 m from the water under continuous canopy, so the satellite alone could not confirm; the photos decide it. Under AWH's 2026-11-10 rule (a few clearly waterfront sites = waterfront with a caveat naming them) the note now names them. 012 is FCFS; 018/019 are reservable. Old evidence ('sites strung along the NE shore ... at the waterline') overstated it; suggest new evidence text: 'rec.gov site photos: 006, 012, 018, 019 with lake directly beyond the table across open ground; others behind trees (overlay of rec.gov points on imagery)'.

Sites: count 32 -> 29 (rec.gov's 29 standard sites; the stored 32 included the 2 cabins and the group site). The FS page says '30 campsites'. Site 011 is the host. Short pads: 025 is listed at 14 ft and 032 at 21 ft; the rest are 30 ft or more (36+ for most).

RV wording (agency's own, FS page): 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Most can accommodate a moderately sized vehicle.' Not a road warning; rec.gov lengths show 26 of the 29 sites at 36 ft or more. Kept in the note.
Status: FS page reads 'Site Partially Closed' / 'Closed–No fees or services (gated)' now, the normal post-September-26 closure; season dates written. No status change.

Missing phone: rec.gov lists 'CONCESSIONAIRE (SUMMER): 218-365-2963' (contact info 'For facility specific information, please call (218) 365-2963') and the Kawishiwi Ranger District, 218-365-7600. Suggest 218-365-2963.
Websites: both stored URLs (FS page and rec.gov 233841) answer 200 and are this campground.
Fees: the FS page also carries an older line ('Single Site: $19 per night, Double Site: $60, Cabin: $89') next to the current '$21/night'; rec.gov's 2026 and 2027 rate tables say $21, written.
Pin 47.75860,-91.78560 is on the campground entrance road west of the loops, about 180 m from the south loop; under 250 m, no move needed.
